NATIONAL COMMISSION OF SENIOR CITIZENS · REGION IV-A

ECAP Approved List

The National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC) – Regional Office IV-A provides this directory to facilitate convenient access to the list of approved grantees under the Expanded Centenarian Act (ECA) Program, pursuant to Republic Act No. 11982.


This platform serves as a reference for Local Government Units (LGUs) in reviewing grantee records and updating their living status to help maintain accurate and up-to-date information.

Instructions for Concerned LGUs

To access your records, select Province and open the file for your LGU. Please thoroughly review the list of approved grantees and update the living status of each grantee. If you find any errors or data that need to be corrected, please coordinate with the focal person assigned to your province.


Piliin ang Province at buksan ang file ng inyong LGU. Masusing suriin ang listahan ng mga aprubadong benepisyaryo at i-update ang katayuan kung buhay pa ang bawat benepisyaryo. Kung may makita kayong maling impormasyon o kailangang itama, makipag-ugnayan sa focal person na nakatalaga sa inyong lalawigan.
